goal: Implement dual-destination (private chat + group channel) delivery in TelegramNotifier on Render backend

function_signatures: _send_message(self, text: str, parse_mode: str = 'HTML', reply_markup: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, target_chat_id: Optional[str] = None) -> bool

execution_steps: Run python -m unittest test_telegram_dual_delivery.py to confirm red phase failure
Update TelegramNotifier.__init__ in telegram_bot.py to accept group_chat_id or resolve os.getenv('TELEGRAM_GROUP_CHAT_ID', '-1004384607143')
Update TelegramNotifier._send_message in telegram_bot.py to deliver to all unique configured chat IDs (private and group) when target_chat_id is None
Add TELEGRAM_GROUP_CHAT_ID to render.yaml environment variables with sync: false
Run python -m unittest test_telegram_dual_delivery.py to confirm green phase
Update contract status to PASSED and validate using validate_contract.js
acceptance_criteria: TelegramNotifier initializes group_chat_id from TELEGRAM_GROUP_CHAT_ID or default '-1004384607143'

render.yaml declares TELEGRAM_GROUP_CHAT_ID as sync: false
All unit tests pass with zero regressions
